title: POST /schedules – request
description: Create a schedule of a route of the caller. list mode: start_times; interval mode: interval_from, interval_to, interval_every_min. Absent time_limit_min: ceil(walk_duration_s × 1.5 / 300) × 5 minutes from the current version of the route (at most 1440), 20 without a measured walk; null: no limit. interval_from = interval_to is not allowed. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Response: 201, api/schedule.response.json.

id.description: Optional client-generated id (UUIDv7) of the new record; the server generates one if absent.

weekdays.description: Bit mask of start days: 1 = Monday, 2 = Tuesday, 4 = Wednesday, 8 = Thursday, 16 = Friday, 32 = Saturday, 64 = Sunday.

start_times.description: list mode: a sequence from the start day; an element not later than the previous one is on the next day (at most one such step, and then the last element is earlier than the first).

anyOf.description: Time limit of a round in minutes; null = no limit.
